{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blouse: relaxed long-sleeve blouse with a soft tie neck, hip-grazing length, rust terracotta #B5502D, matte satin-finish crepe

Trousers: high-waisted straight-leg trousers, ankle length, deep forest green #24493A, wool-blend crepe

Trench coat: single-breasted trench, knee length, belted, camel #B98B5A, water-repellent cotton gabardine

Ankle boots: block-heel ankle boots with a rounded toe, dark chocolate #3B2518, waterproof smooth leather

Bag: structured top-handle bag, medium size, burgundy #5E1A2A, grained leather

Earrings: medium hoop earrings, warm gold #C9A24B, polished brass

Umbrella: compact automatic umbrella, dark olive #3E4A2F, windproof nylon

This outfit stays within a neat business look, with a blouse, tailored trousers, ankle boots and a trench, while the rust and forest green pairing gives the bold, memorable color she wants for a client meeting. These warm, deep shades suit her warm skin, dark brown hair and hazel eyes, so the color works for her rather than overpowering her. The high-waisted straight trousers and belted trench create a long, clean line, and the soft tie neck adds a point of interest near the face. The waterproof boots, water-repellent trench and umbrella keep her polished and dry through a rainy autumn day, so she can focus on the client."}
